text:
ashley: PTAL — addressed the backcompat comments, added a migration flag and squashed commits into one. CI passed unit tests locally but the integration job timed out once. I pushed fixups.

ryan: quick q — migration flag default? will it flip on existing deployments?

ashley: default: off. I added a note in CHANGELOG and a rollout plan in the PR description. config example:
```yaml
feature_migration:
  enabled: false
```
Also added a migration script under `ops/migrations/2026-03-add-flag.sh`.

linh: can you add a tiny unit test for the decoder path? makes backcompat less scary.

ashley: yep added test `tests/test_migration_flag.py` — covers old/new model behavior, CI should pick it up.

dev-bot: [CI] Integration job rerun queued — currently: running (flake: timeout during docker pull). Link: https://ci.internal/3127778888

marco: I can give eyes after standup (~10:30 PT). if CI is flaky we should wait for green to avoid revert.

ryan: if it's squashed we need to ensure commit message includes migration rationale. Also, what's the rollback plan if canary shows issues?

ashley: added rollback steps in PR description (revert, pin previous model, disable flag). commit message updated. hoping for a quick LGTM, then target canary today afternoon. @marco PTAL when you can :thumbsup: 

linh: LGTM on tests, left one tiny nit inline (naming).

ashley: fixed naming nit, force-pushed. PTAL again.

marco: eyeballing now. :eyes:

ashley: pinging for merge window — if all good I'll merge at 15:00 PT and watch canary.
